correctness.rationale: For a quadratic H restricted to an edge, phi prime at 1/2 equals H(v_j)-H(v_i). The four-vertex degree<=2 evaluation E has rank four and its two-dimensional kernel is the opposite-side conic pencil; the net is E inverse of the all-equal diagonal. Tested edges enforce constant E(H) on connected components, yielding exactly the net iff graph connected. If disconnected, surjectivity gives an outside polynomial, and adding a nonzero pencil member yields a genuine degree-two outside conic. Cayley gives 16 spanning trees; two opposite-pair members of the second pencil give six incidences. This is universal in the stated nondegenerate characteristic-ne-2 setting.
